title: Records Concerning FBI Investigations of the Atomwaffen Division and Related Entities (2017–2021), Including Confidential Human Source Activity

communications.communication:
To Whom It May Concern:

Pursuant to the Freedom of Information Act, I hereby request the following records:

This is a request under the Freedom of Information Act, 5 U.S.C. § 552.

I request the following records from January 1, 2017, through December 31, 2021:

1. Any final investigative reports, closing memoranda, summary reports, or significant event reports concerning the Atomwaffen Division (also known as Atomwaffen or AWD) or its successor, the National Socialist Order, that reference or discuss the use of confidential human sources (CHS), including any authorizations for otherwise illegal activity by a CHS in connection with AWD.

2. Records of payments, expense advances, or other compensation provided to any confidential human source(s) in connection with FBI investigations of the Atomwaffen Division, particularly those related to the investigation and prosecution in United States v. Kaleb Cole, Case No. 2:20-cr-00032-JCC (W.D. Wash.). This includes any payment logs, approval forms, or accounting records reflecting payments beginning on or around February 7, 2018.

3. Any records discussing the relationship between the Atomwaffen Division (or its members or activities) and the Tempel ov Blood, Martinet Press, or U.S.-based activities of the Order of Nine Angles, to the extent such records were compiled in the course of the AWD investigation or related domestic terrorism/extremism investigations during the date range above.

4. Any inter-office or field-office communications (e.g., between the Columbia, SC Field Office or other relevant offices and FBI Headquarters) concerning CHS reporting on Atomwaffen Division activities, events, or members during 2017–2021, including but not limited to events such as the 2018 Death Valley Hate Camp or 2019 Nuclear Congress.

Please search the Central Records System (CRS) and any other relevant systems or field-office holdings. Provide all reasonably segregable non-exempt portions. I request that any withholdings be justified by specific exemption citations and that a Vaughn index (or equivalent) be provided for any fully withheld records.

I request a fee waiver under 5 U.S.C. § 552(a)(4)(A)(iii). Disclosure of these records is in the public interest because it concerns the operations and activities of the federal government (specifically, the FBI’s use of confidential human sources in domestic extremism investigations, the expenditure of public funds, and the handling of sources who continued public activities associated with extremist groups). The information is likely to contribute to public understanding of these operations, and I have no commercial interest in the records. I am prepared to pay reasonable fees up to $25 if the waiver is denied; please notify me in advance of any estimated costs exceeding that amount.

Please provide the records in electronic format if available. My contact information is: Christina Urso, 8409 Manassas Circle, Vienna, VA 22180, email: radixverum29@protonmail.com.

The requested documents will be made available to the general public, and this request is not being made for commercial purposes.

In the event that there are fees, I would be grateful if you would inform me of the total charges in advance of fulfilling my request. I would prefer the request filled electronically, by e-mail attachment if available or CD-ROM if not.

Thank you in advance for your anticipated cooperation in this matter. I look forward to receiving your response to this request within 20 business days, as the statute requires.

Sincerely,

Christina L. Urso
